name: Houston West RV Park

note: Family-owned nightly RV park off I-10 in Brookshire (~30 mi W of Houston); 200+ level full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, pull-through and back-in, pool, laundry, camp store, dog parks and a ~3-acre stocked fishing pond; daily/weekly/monthly. --Claude

name: Stars over Texas RV Park-Frio
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Deluxe Back In 30 amp, Deluxe Back In 30/50 amp, Deluxe Back In 50 amp, Premium Pull Through 50 amp, Deluxe Covered Back In 30 amp and 2 more). October 2026: $55-70 on a Tuesday; $60-75 on a Saturday. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Plus the park's $5 'Reservation Surcharge', once per stay. The park adds 3% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card Fee'. Read 2026-10-13.
note: Destination RV park in the Frio River canyon on US 83 at Concan, about 2.7 miles from Garner State Park, with oak-shaded sites, fire pits, patios and some covered spaces, cable TV, a pool, a playground, a community building, a fishing pond stocked with catfish, bass and perch, and rental cabins. --Claude

name: Stone Creek RV Park
fees_note: Daily $58 with 30-amp, $61 with 50-amp, double occupancy; weekly $310-330; monthly $630-675 plus metered electric. The page gives no year. Read 2026-10-14.
note: Large family-owned western-themed RV park on I-35 in Schertz between San Antonio and New Braunfels; 324 full-hookup big-rig sites incl. covered-patio sites, pools, hot tub, rec halls, dog parks, camp store. Overnight/seasonal/extended; reservable online. --Claude

name: The Palms RV Park
fees_note: Regular sites from $55 a day; $49.50 with the 10% Good Sam discount. Read 2026-10-14.
note: Coastal RV park in Aransas Pass, ~136 full-hookup sites (RV only, big-rig pull-throughs), solar-heated pool and spa, laundry, free WiFi; a short drive to the Port Aransas ferry and Rockport. --Claude

name: Whispering Oaks RV Park
fees_note: Full hookup pull-through $55 for 2, utilities included.
note: Private I-10 (Exit 689) stopover park on 6 acres of live oaks in Weimar, between San Antonio and Houston. 51 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, 42 large pull-throughs, asphalt roads with crushed-granite pads, fire ring + picnic table per site; big-rig friendly. Reservable online. --Claude

name: USA RV Park
fees_note: With tax, 2 people: water + electric $45.95 + tax = $54.45, full hookup $47.95 + tax; club discounts 10%.
note: Commercial RV park on Historic Route 66 just off I-40 west of Gallup. Full-hookup pull-through sites (30/50 amp), seasonal heated pool, laundry, gift shop/convenience store, game room, and mid-May-to-early-Oct cowboy cookouts; cabins also offered. Reservable online or by phone. --Claude

name: Sunny Acres RV Park
fees_note: Full hookup with tax, without discount: back-ins $55, pull-throughs $60-66 ($50-60 with discount).
note: Adults-only (50+) RV park in central Las Cruces with Organ Mountains views. Large gravel full-hookup 50-amp sites (mostly back-in plus some pull-through) with patios, big-rig capable; laundry, community room, pickleball, and dog run. Nightly, weekly, and monthly rates. Reservable via the office. --Claude

name: Boot Hill RV Resort
fees_note: Standard RV site $55 plus tax; covered deluxe sites more.
note: Private RV park ~5 mi north of Alamogordo on US-54/70: 50 sites (19 pull-through, 31 back-in), full hookups with 30/50 amp, big-rig capable, RV covers/patios, laundry, showers, exercise room, dog runs. Nightly/weekly/monthly (nightly ~$27). Reservable by phone. --Claude

name: Kiva RV Park and Horse Motel
fees_note: Full hookup 30/50A $55; horse pens extra.
note: I-25 exit 175 RV park with an attached horse motel (corrals); general RV park with full-hookup 20/30/50-amp big-rig pull-throughs, WiFi, laundry, rec room. Some interstate noise. --Claude

name: Crazy Horse RV Resort
fees_note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-14): $55 a night for a back-in site and $59.95 for a pull-through, plus tax. These are standard rates; premium sites may cost more. Weekly, monthly and annual rates are lower.
note: RV resort in Kanab with full-hookup back-in and pull-through sites (30- and 50-amp) on large gravel pads, plus tent sites, yurts, Conestoga glamping wagons and apartments.  Pool, bathhouse, laundry, general store, dog park and a dump station.  Stays by the day, week, month or year, booked online through ResNexus. --Claude

name: Zion West RV Park
fees_note: Pull-throughs $55 cash, $57 card, tax included.
note: Small year-round full-hookup RV park in Leeds (175 S Valley Rd), gateway to Zion/Snow Canyon/Red Cliffs, ~10 min to St George. All sites full hookup 30/50-amp with spring water & sewer, mix of pull-through, back-in and tent sites; free WiFi/cable. --Claude

name: Nisqually Plaza RV Park
fees_note: Daily $58, taxes and fees included, for 2 people.
note: Transient full-hookup RV park just off I-5 near the Nisqually delta, a convenient overnight stopover between Olympia and Tacoma. ~50 full-hookup sites, restrooms/showers, laundry, dump station; noted as not big-rig friendly (fine for a 23-ft rig). --Claude

name: Rain Forest Resort Village
fees_note: Lakeside water + 30A back-in sites $68 plus tax.
note: Resort on the south shore of Lake Quinault (516 S Shore Rd) in the Quinault Rain Forest. 31 back-in RV sites with water + 30-amp electric (no sewer/dump on site); on-site restaurant and store, coin showers; open year-round (restrooms closed in winter); nightly ~$68; adjacent to the World's Largest Spruce. --Claude

name: Skagit River RV & Camping
fees_note: RV sites $60 a night; tents $45.
note: Small family-run RV park in Marblemount on SR 20 (60751 State Route 20), ~20 min from North Cascades NP; full-hookup pull-through RV sites with 30-amp, fire ring and picnic table each, plus large grassy tent sites; showers, restrooms, laundry; reservable. On the Wild & Scenic Skagit River. --Claude

name: Campbell Cove RV Resort
fees_note: Full hookup for 2: summer $55-65, winter (Oct-Apr) $60-70; 50A $5 more.
note: Private full-hookup RV resort on a hill in the industrial area of Lake Havasu City, ~1.5 mi east of the lake. ~121-124 sites, 30/50-amp full hookups + wifi, heated pool & spa, laundry, gazebo; pets welcome. Nightly/transient (no age restriction), advertised panoramic Lake Havasu views. --Claude

name: Prince of Tucson RV Park
fees_note: $60 plus tax for 1-2 people; Good Sam $54.
note: Private RV park on the NW side of Tucson just off I-10 (N Freeway Rd). ~180 sites, full hookups, easy-in pull-throughs for overnighters, laundry; daily/weekly/monthly/yearly rates, no age restriction (families welcome; rig-age policy 10 yrs & newer). Sites are tightly spaced per reviews. --Claude
why: gateway: Tucson 6 km, Saguaro NP 15 km

name: Rancho Verde RV Park
fees_note: $65-80 plus 12.975% tax, by site and season.
note: Boutique adult-oriented RV park (~40 level full-hookup 30/50-amp sites) in Camp Verde with pull-thrus, big-rig access and mature shade trees; open year-round, nightly. Distinct from the larger Verde Ranch RV Resort next door. --Claude

name: Redding RV Park
fees_note: Plus tax: 30/50A back-ins $55, pull-throughs $59.
note: Commercial big-rig RV park just off I-5 in north Redding (11075 Campers Court). 80 full-hookup sites, 55 pull-throughs to 70 ft, 30/50-amp, pool, laundry, WiFi; transient nightly (~$43-47). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Bayfort Camp
fees_note: Hydro/water sites $90 with HST ($79.65 + HST).
note: Third-generation family camp on the Georgian Bay shore at 3321 Ogdens Beach Rd, about 5 km east of Midland and just east of Martyrs' Shrine. Mostly seasonal (165 seasonal sites) but holds a designated travellers' section of 15 hydro/water overnight sites on 30 amp, plus 30 tenting sites. Private sandy beach, recreation hall with snack bar, several playgrounds, three washroom buildings (one with showers), dump station. --Claude
why: gateway: Georgian Bay Islands NP 14 km

name: Bow RiversEdge Campground
fees_note: 30A $71, 50A $81; Good Sam 10% off.
note: Private full-service campground on the Bow River at 100 Campground Road, Cochrane; 144 sites all with power/water/sewer and WiFi, each ~75 ft long x 25 ft wide, big-rig friendly. Camping season Apr 1-Oct 31 (long-term winter sites Nov-Mar). Welcomes both short-term/nightly and longer stays; reservable online. --Claude

name: Spring Hill RV Park
fees_note: Plus GST: $70 and $80 by site type; Calgary Stampede $80-90.
note: Private full-service RV park at the corner of Hwy 22 and Big Hill Springs Rd (Hwy 567), ~7 km north of Cochrane; gateway to the Rockies near Calgary/Kananaskis. Large pull-through sites with 30/50-amp power, water and sewer able to handle the largest coaches; on-site convenience store, gas/diesel/propane, liquor store, and Meaghan's Pond free trout fishing. Nightly transient sites plus winter camping with full hookups. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Stoney Creek Resort
fees_note: 2025 rates, still posted, for 2 adults and 3 children: water and electric $62 a day, standard full hookup $68, premium full hookup $71 (lakefront $77); weekly, monthly and seasonal rates too. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends, paid in advance. Read 2026-10-14.
note: Large independent resort on 200+ acres beside its own Stoney Creek Lake near Greenville, ~23 km from Shenandoah NP. The operator's campground map numbers RV sites 1-198 on the lake level and 199-341 on the upper property: water/electric, standard full-hookup and premium (lake-view and lakefront) sites, plus tent sites T1-T12, bunkhouses and cabins. Nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays; reservations by phone, check-in at the general store. Off-season storage runs Nov 1-Mar 31, so camping runs roughly April through October. Pool, mini golf, clubhouse and grill, camp store, laundry, swim beach. --Claude

name: Sleepy Hollow Campground & RV Park
fees_note: The range is the RV-site ladder, priced by hookup class (water+30/20 amp at the bottom, full hookups + cable + 50 amp at the top), all plus sales tax. Tent sites $32.88, or $37.88 with 20-amp. Cancelling outside the 7-day window keeps $20 (RV) / $15 (tent); inside it, the whole booking is forfeit, as is a no-show.
note: In-town campground one block north of Wall Drug at the north edge of Wall, the gateway town for Badlands NP and Buffalo Gap National Grassland. 59 pull-thru RV sites in rows A-G, all with water and 30/20 or 50/30/20 amp electric; many add sewer and/or cable; sites 9-10B are the ones recommended for high-profile big rigs. Separate tent sites. Showers, laundry, dog park, campground-wide wifi; the swimming pool is GONE - guests use the City of Wall pool. Open May 1 - Oct 15, RV rates $55.88-$67.88 plus tax, 10% veteran and active-military discount, check-in 1pm and check-out 11am MST, 7-day cancellation. Priced above the sweep's usual private gate. RV Life 4*/$$$ (auto 9/2026)

name: Fort Welikit Family Campground
fees_note: 2025 (May-Oct), 2 adults, with cable: 20/30A back-ins $53-54, 50/30A full hookup $59-66; Sturgis $58-71.
note: 100 sites in the pines on the Norbeck Byway a mile north of Custer, close to Crazy Horse, Sylvan Lake, the Needles and Jewel Cave. Full-hookup 50-amp pull-throughs and 30/50-amp back-ins with free cable, water-and-electric sites, and rustic and group sites; tipis and cabins too. Open May 1 to October 15. Priced above the sweep's usual private gate. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ (auto 9/2026)
why: gateway: Mount Rushmore 15 km, Wind Cave NP 27 km

name: Chris' Camp & RV Park
fees_note: 2026: RV water + electric $53, full hookup $58-63, premium $65; Sturgis Rally rates separate.
note: Family-run for 40-plus years on the north edge of Spearfish, handy to I-90 and Spearfish Canyon. About 228 sites from deluxe pull-thru full hookups to shaded tent sites and primitive camping cabins, with three heated pools, two laundromats, rec room, playground, basketball court, dump station and site fire pits; a small animal farm for the kids. Good Sam Park with a military discount. Priced above the sweep's usual private gate. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ (auto 9/2026)

name: Southern Hills RV Park & Campground
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Standard Site and Super Site). October 2026: $55-65, Tuesday and Saturday alike. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Plus the park's $3 'Booking Fee', once per stay. The park adds 3.3% of the site charge as a 'Credit Card Processing Fee'. Read 2026-10-13.
note: Campground among ponderosa pines and rolling hills on SD-79 at Hermosa, a base for Mount Rushmore, Crazy Horse and Deadwood.  It has spacious sites, a dog park, a fire pit and propane; Dollar General and the Lazy R are within walking distance, and Corner Pantry is half a mile away.  Monthly stays are offered at a discounted rate from November 1 to April 1. --Claude
why: gateway: Mount Rushmore 21 km, Wind Cave NP 39 km

name: Pellicer Creek Campground
fees_note: $65 with electricity.
note: Shaded full-hookup RV campground (30/50 A, water, sewer, cable, Wi-Fi) on US-1 at Pellicer Creek, south of St Augustine near Faver-Dykes State Park. 2026 daily $65 incl. electricity; weekly $425, monthly $975 + electric. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude

name: Seven Springs Travel Park
fees_note: 2026-27 daily $60 with electricity, for 2.
note: RV park on Old County Rd 54 in New Port Richey, near the Gulf coast north of Tampa. 2026 daily $60 incl. electricity and Wi-Fi, weekly $360, monthly and seasonal too. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude

name: Rockwell RV Resort
fees_note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (30/50 Amp Full Hook up W/Grass Back In, 30/50 Full Hook Up Back In, 30/50 Full Hook Up Pull Through and Premium 30/50 Full Hook Up Pull Through). October 2026, January 2027 and June 2027: $65, Tuesday and Saturday alike. The park adds a 'Booking Fee' of $1.95 a night on a $65 site, 3% of the site charge. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13.
note: RV park at 720 S Rockwell Ave, just off I-40 on the west side of Oklahoma City, open for over 30 years and now under new ownership: 170 full-hookup sites, 20 to 25 ft wide and up to 80 ft long, many of them pull-throughs.  It shares a property line with Crystal Lake, stocked with sunfish and catfish, and sits on a paved regional bike trail.  There is an indoor heated pool, spa and sauna, two bathhouses with private showers, a laundry, fiber Wi-Fi throughout, a storm shelter, propane exchange and refills, workout machines, a dog park and a playground. --Claude

name: Sunrise RV Resort
fees_note: Standard/premium from $59-82 May-Sept 2026, $81-84 Oct-Dec, $100-104 Jan-Mar 2027.
note: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+. Roberts Resorts RV resort at 1403 W Broadway Ave, Apache Junction; online booking (Newbook); rates not published. RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude

name: Orange Grove RV Park
fees_note: Standard $70, premium $80 April-November; standard $85, premium $100 December-March (2026-27). A 55+ park. From our own note (entry added 2026-10-05); not re-confirmed with the operator as of 2026-10-11.
note: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+. Cobblestone-run RV and home community on Nuna Ave off Palm Beach Blvd (SR-80), east Fort Myers. Daily RV rates (2026-27): standard site $85, premium $100 Dec-Mar; standard $70, premium $80 Apr-Nov. Park models and manufactured homes share the grounds with the RV section. Books on Campspot. --Claude

name: Lakes RV
fees_note: Nightly from $65 in summer to $110-120 daily in winter (lakefront highest).
note: RV park on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl) beside Lakes Regional Park, Fort Myers. 2026 daily rates: standard 30/50-amp back-in $110 winter (Jan-Mar), $75 Apr and Nov-Dec, $65 summer; pull-through $110/$85/$70; lakefront sites $120 winter, $95 Apr and Nov-Dec, $75 summer. Weekly and monthly too (winter lakefront monthlies need 3 months). --Claude

name: Seminole Campground
fees_note: Summer rates $85/day, $510/week; winter by the month.
note: Wooded RV park on Triplett Rd off SR-31 near I-75 exit 143, North Fort Myers, with Popash Creek running through it. $85/day summer (operator); RV Life's owner-managed page lists nightly rates $73-100 by site type. Full hookups, 30/50 amp. --Claude

name: Gulf Waters RV Resort
fees_note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults from a Tuesday and from a Saturday, site rate before tax - November 2026 (10th and 14th): Standard $85.05; Prime $106.05; Luxury $117.60; Luxury Plus $123.48; Luxury Lakefront $128.10; Luxury Lakefront Plus $134.51. January 2027 (12th and 16th): Standard $117.60; Prime $131.25; Luxury $141.75; Luxury Plus $148.84; Luxury Lakefront $156.45; Luxury Lakefront Plus $164.27. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. The resort's rate card charges the November prices in November and April, the January ones December through March, and $83.35 a night for every site May to October. Plus the park's $3 campground fee, once per stay. Read 2026-10-13.
note: Lot-ownership RV resort off Summerlin Rd near the Fort Myers Beach causeway that rents owners' sites by the night.  Travel trailers only May to October, and an RV that doesn't match its booking (type, length, age, condition) can be turned away at check-in without a refund. --Claude

name: Encore Gulf Air RV Resort
fees_note: Encore Gulf Air booking engine, one night Nov 10-11 2026: standard full hookup (Nov-March RVs 40 ft or less) $68, premium $84, elite $93 a night; weekly rates lower.
note: Encore (ELS) resort on San Carlos Blvd on the way to Fort Myers Beach; books single nights to the public. Online daily rates from $68 (standard full hookup; Nov-Mar RVs 40 ft or less) to $113 (2026-27). Single midweek nights bookable; 2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on holidays. --Claude

name: Encore Tranquility Lakes RV Resort
fees_note: Encore Tranquility Lakes booking engine, one night Nov 10-11 2026: deluxe full-hookup RV sites $114, deluxe lakefront back-in $136, lakefront $147 a night (weekly rates lower).
note: Newer Encore (ELS) resort on Burnt Store Rd, northwest Cape Coral, built around a large lake; sites ring the shore. Campers reported $90-100 a night in January 2025 (Campendium); book online. RVs over 10 years old need management approval. --Claude

name: Sugar Sand Beach RV Resort
fees_note: Daily $120 (Nov-May), $100 summer; 2-night minimum on weekends; plus sales and tourist taxes.
note: Small (11-site) RV resort at the end of Porpoise Point Rd in Matlacha, on Matlacha Pass. Daily $120 Nov-May, $100 Jun-Oct (2-night minimum on weekends); monthly too. Rates plus 6.5% sales and 5% Lee County tourist tax. --Claude

name: Bonita Lake RV Resort
fees_note: Daily $92 (premium $102) Dec-Mar; off season Apr-Nov $83 (premium $93); 1-2 occupants, $5 per extra.
note: RV resort on Old 41 Rd, Bonita Springs, alongside a canal and pond. 2026-27 daily rates: $92 (premium $102) in season; $83 (premium $93) Apr 1-Nov 30. Rates for one or two people, $5/night per extra. --Claude

name: Imperial Bonita Estates
fees_note: Daily: back-in $59, pull-thru $69, premium $87 per night (weekly rates work out to $46-$69).
note: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+. Resident-owned co-op off Bonita Beach Rd by the Imperial River that rents RV lots nightly. Online daily rates: back-in $59, pull-through $69, premium (pull-through or river lot) $87; weekly works out to $46-69/night. --Claude

name: Sanctuary RV Resort
fees_note: Summer daily $57.55-$63.57/night (longer stays less); winter rates not shown.
note: All-ages Roots-managed RV resort on Bonita Beach Rd SE, east of I-75, 185 paved sites. Online summer daily rates $53.85-63.03 (2026); in season the online booking shows only 90- to 180-day stays, so call for winter nights. --Claude

name: Swan Lake RV Village
fees_note: Daily $77 for RVs up to 34 ft, $88 for 35 ft and larger or 50 amp.
note: Park-model and RV village on US-41 (N Tamiami Trl), North Fort Myers; the transient RV loop sits south of the park-model streets. Daily $77 for RVs up to 34 ft, $88 for 35 ft+ or 50-amp, full hookups, 1-2 people ($5/day per extra). Weekly and monthly too; season stays book with a deposit by August 1. The park says Sunday and after-dark arrivals are discouraged. --Claude

name: Sun Retreats Estero Bay
fees_note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults from a Tuesday and from a Saturday, site rate before tax - November 2026 (10th and 14th): Standard Full Hookup RV Site $100; Deluxe Full Hookup Concrete RV Site, Deluxe Full Hookup Lakefront RV Site and Deluxe Full Hookup Paver RV Site $105; Premium Full Hookup Pull Through RV Site $112. January 2027 (12th and 16th): Standard Full Hookup RV Site $110; Deluxe Full Hookup Concrete RV Site, Deluxe Full Hookup Lakefront RV Site and Deluxe Full Hookup Paver RV Site $118; Premium Full Hookup Pull Through RV Site $135.45. June 2027 (15th and 19th): Standard Full Hookup RV Site $79; Deluxe Full Hookup Concrete RV Site, Deluxe Full Hookup Lakefront RV Site and Deluxe Full Hookup Paver RV Site $83; Premium Full Hookup Pull Through RV Site $84. November's prices include the park's $10-a-night campground fee; January and June have none. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13.
note: All-ages Sun Outdoors RV resort on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl) in south Fort Myers, set around two ponds.  Pond-front sites take a 28-night minimum in winter. --Claude

name: Fort Myers / Pine Island KOA Holiday
fees_note: koa.com booking for February 2027, read by AWH on 2026-10-05: back-in full hookup (50/30/20 amp) $104.50 a night, lakeside back-in $156.75.
note: KOA Holiday on Stringfellow Rd, St. James City, on Pine Island; pool, cabins and cottages, near the island's 17-mile bike path. February 2027 rates: back-in full hookup (50/30/20 amp) $104.50; lakeside back-in full hookup $156.75. --Claude

name: Elk Ridge Campground
fees_note: All sites $51.76 a night before tax ($56 with it), read by AWH from the booking engine 2026-10-05; $46.58 with the 10% Good Sam discount.
note: Small campground on WA-410 along the Naches River, about 16 miles NW of Naches toward Chinook Pass: 20 water/electric RV sites among the pines, plus tent sites. Books through ResNexus. --Claude

name: Camping Bas-Saint-Laurent
fees_note: Full-hookup RV sites C$71 a night (pull-through) or C$73 (back-in) on a July 2027 weeknight, plus tax; C$63.90 with the 10% Good Sam discount. Read 2026-10-08.
note: Large campground on Lac Saint-Mathieu at Saint-Mathieu-de-Rioux, south of Trois-Pistoles: deluxe and regular RV sites (mostly pull-through, five services), tent sites, cabins and chalets, and a big seasonal section. Pool, mini golf, playgrounds, beach and lake access, activities all season. --Claude

name: Leafy Oaks Campground
fees_note: RV sites $51.50-57.50 a night with water and electric, $57.50 for a waterfront back-in full hookup, $62.50 for a full-hookup pull-through (a Saturday in October 2026); $46.35 and up with the 10% Good Sam discount. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Family campground at 6955 OH-101 near Clyde, in Seneca County: back-in water/electric sites, full-hookup pull-throughs and back-ins, buddy sites, tent sites, cabins and rental campers, plus seasonal sites. Swimming pond with a sand beach, fishing, camp store, live music on summer weekends. Open April to October. --Claude

name: Timberline West RV Campground
fees_note: Water/electric sites $54 a night and full hookups $59, the same in October, January and June; $48.60 and $53.10 with the 10% Good Sam discount. Booking online adds a 4% card fee and a $3 convenience fee per stay. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Large RV campground at 31635 SE Ashworth Rd, Waukee, just west of Des Moines: full-hookup and water/electric sites (20/30/50 amp, pull-throughs), furnished cabins and tent sites; open all year. Sister park Timberline East is at Newton. --Claude
